questions.question: In what year was Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull released?
questions.note: Nineteen years after The Last Crusade. Spielberg directed; Lucas still produced.

questions.question: Who plays Soviet agent Irina Spalko in Kingdom of the Crystal Skull?
questions.note: Blonde bob, fencing rapier, psychic experiments. The film is set in 1957.

questions.question: Who plays Mutt Williams, the greaser who turns out to be Indy’s son?
questions.note: Marion Ravenwood is his mother. He swings through the jungle on vines. It is a choice.

questions.question: Which Raiders co-star returns as Marion in Kingdom of the Crystal Skull?
questions.note: Same Marion, older, still throwing punches. They finally get married at the end.

questions.question: Who directed Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny, the first Indy film Spielberg did not direct?
questions.note: Mangold made Logan and Ford v Ferrari. Spielberg and Lucas stayed on as producers.

questions.question: Who plays Helena Shaw, Indy’s goddaughter, in Dial of Destiny?
questions.note: The Fleabag writer-star. Mads Mikkelsen is the ex-Nazi physicist Jürgen Voller.

questions.question: In what year was Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny released?
questions.note: Ford was 80. The opening uses digital de-aging, then the plot jumps to 1969.

questions.question: What kind of hat is part of Indiana Jones’s regular outfit?
questions.note: He loses it constantly and always gets it back. The Last Crusade opening explains where the first one came from.

questions.question: What does Indiana Jones teach when he is not in the field?
questions.note: Marshall College. Students pack the lecture hall. He still cannot spell “X never, ever marks the spot” without finding an X.

questions.question: What is Indiana Jones’s full name, as used in the films?
questions.note: Dad is Henry Jones Sr. “Indiana” is the dog, then the nickname. Some tie-in material adds Walton; nights want Jr.
